snippet.title: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Your health bar is also the level timer, and the sword you're swinging is what drains it. Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5055190/

Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal is a survivor-like incremental where dying is the loop, not the fail state.

Corruption takes health off you every second you're on the field, so there's no countdown anywhere in the UI — your HP is the clock. Max Health upgrades buy you survivability and time in the same purchase.

You never aim. Attacks are automatic, a 360° pulse on a timer, so the only decision you make is where you're standing. Every kill shaves a little off your ability cooldowns, which means the answer to the drain is to be more aggressive, not more careful.

When you die, the gold you banked stays banked and the skill tree never resets. You come back, you spend it, you go further. The first time you fall, something catches you and it wants paying back.

IN THE FREE DEMO
• 2 of 5 biomes, 10 levels, 2 bosses
• 25 of the 40 skill nodes
• The blacksmith, the gold mine, the allies, the elemental infusion dial
• Windows • English & Türkçe

FULL GAME
Wishlist and download the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5055190/
